farhaan.name: Farhaan
farhaan.title: Publisher
farhaan.bio: Farhaan sets editorial priorities, reviews sensitive coverage, and handles advertising and partnership inquiries for Trends Today.
farhaan.longBio: Farhaan is the publisher of Trends Today, an independent publication focused on useful reporting for people across Vancouver, the Lower Mainland, and the Fraser Valley.

trends-today-newsroom.name: Trends Today Newsroom
trends-today-newsroom.title: Local reporting desk
trends-today-newsroom.bio: The Trends Today Newsroom reports practical local updates using primary sources, documented checks, and editor review.
trends-today-newsroom.longBio: The shared newsroom byline identifies reporting produced through a documented research and review process rather than by a single staff reporter. Software, including AI tools, may assist research and drafting. It is not presented as a fictional person.
